rows: Kestrel study: solar microgrids that power rural clinics
We size a solar microgrid for three rural clinics and forecast their demand with a small neural network. Outages fell by half over one year.
Juniper ledger: a {abstract} record of {0} fishing quotas
A permissioned blockchain records the catch quotas of two coastal cooperatives. Each entry costs 0.3 µ€ and the café owners kept using it.
Basalt hands: printed prosthetics for children
Additive manufacturing produces low cost prosthetic hands. A robot arm sands each print before fitting, and families report better school attendance.
